dimensions.name: Hook Strength
dimensions.description: The first 1-3 seconds create a curiosity gap, make a specific promise, or trigger recognition. Would a viewer stop scrolling?
dimensions.anchorLow: Generic greeting or statement of topic; no reason to keep watching
dimensions.anchorHigh: Immediate, specific, emotionally charged; viewer cannot scroll without missing a concrete answer

dimensions.name: Retention
dimensions.description: Every 3-5 seconds delivers new information, a turn, or an escalation. No filler sentences, no dead air.
dimensions.anchorLow: Long setup, repeated points, energy drops in the middle
dimensions.anchorHigh: Constant forward motion; each line earns the next second

dimensions.name: Specificity
dimensions.description: Concrete numbers, named objects, real scenarios instead of vague claims and abstract advice.
dimensions.anchorLow: Vague words: 'better', 'faster', 'a lot', no numbers or names
dimensions.anchorHigh: Exact figures, named tools, vivid one-sentence scenes the viewer recognizes

dimensions.name: Originality
dimensions.description: Avoids overused phrases and recycled openings. The angle, framing, or wording feels fresh.
dimensions.anchorLow: Generic advice already seen in dozens of videos, cliché phrasing
dimensions.anchorHigh: A surprising frame, unexpected comparison, or a detail only the writer could know

dimensions.name: Emotional Impact
dimensions.description: Creates a feeling: curiosity, relief, tension, humor, recognition, or motivation. Not neutral information delivery.
dimensions.anchorLow: Dry, detached, reads like a manual
dimensions.anchorHigh: Viewer feels something by line two and keeps feeling it

dimensions.name: Pacing
dimensions.description: Sentence rhythm fits the spoken medium: short lines, varied length, natural spoken English, no written-style clauses.
dimensions.anchorLow: Dense paragraphs, subclauses, formal written English
dimensions.anchorHigh: Punchy spoken lines that sound natural out loud and match the video rhythm
